# ShipKit

Production-ready Next.js 16 starter. Auth, payments, CMS, email, AI, analytics, database, storage are pre-wired. Configure with env vars. Don't build what's already built.

Bones is the root template and the upstream of everything. ShipKit is the everything-included build downstream of Bones; integrations are shadcn registry items you add one at a time.

Identify these projects by the `"shipkit"` field in `package.json`.
If working in one, read the CLAUDE.md. It links to feature-specific docs.

## Create a New App

```
npm create shipkit-app@latest my-app
# or
gh repo create my-app --template shipkit-io/bones --clone --public
cd my-app && <pm> install && cp .env.example .env && <pm> run dev
```

`<pm>` is the package manager named in package.json's `packageManager` field (Bones: pnpm, ShipKit: bun).

## Minimum Required

```
DATABASE_URL - PostgreSQL connection string
AUTH_SECRET  - Encryption key (or APP_SECRET to derive all secrets)
```

## Built-in Features

Everything below is already implemented. Set the env vars to enable it. No code changes needed.

| Feature | Enable With | Details |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| Auth | AUTH_SECRET + AUTH_GITHUB_ID + AUTH_GITHUB_SECRET (or another provider pair) | https://shipkit.io/llms/auth.txt |
| Payments | STRIPE_SECRET_KEY + NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY | https://shipkit.io/llms/payments.txt |
| Database | DATABASE_URL | https://shipkit.io/llms/database.txt |
| CMS | DATABASE_URL + PAYLOAD_SECRET | https://shipkit.io/llms/cms.txt |
| Email | RESEND_API_KEY | https://shipkit.io/llms/email.txt |
| AI | OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY | https://shipkit.io/llms/ai.txt |
| Analytics | NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY (or another provider key) | https://shipkit.io/llms/analytics.txt |
| Storage | AWS_REGION + AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID + AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY + AWS_BUCKET_NAME, or VERCEL_BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN | https://shipkit.io/llms/storage.txt |
| Waitlist | DATABASE_URL | https://shipkit.io/llms/waitlist.txt |
| Registry | npx shadcn add @shipkit/<name> | https://shipkit.io/llms/registry.txt |

Auth library: Auth.js v5 (NextAuth) is what `src/server/auth.ts` runs today. Better Auth is wired as an alternative (BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, routes at /api/better-auth/*). Both are supported. See auth.txt.

## Dev Commands

```
<pm> run dev       - Start dev server
<pm> run build     - Production build
<pm> run test      - Run tests (vitest)
<pm> run lint      - Lint (Biome + ESLint + Prettier)
<pm> run typecheck - Type check
<pm> run db:push   - Push schema to database
```

## Key Rules

- Features auto-enable when env vars are set. Logic: src/config/features-config.ts
- NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_*_ENABLED flags are derived at build time from the service keys. Never set them by hand. Turn a feature off with DISABLE_{FEATURE}=true.
- Package manager: the one in package.json's packageManager field (Bones: pnpm, ShipKit: bun)
- Server Components first, minimize 'use client'
- Server Actions for mutations (src/server/actions/)
- Services for business logic (src/server/services/)
